Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partner paper & pass-through request — CloudResellCo / Redwood

Hi Soojin,

Quick note to kick off the paperwork for our GCP listing. Our marketplace team is asking for language that makes fees and billing passthroughable to the end customer (GCP reseller flow). Attached is the partner paper CloudResellCo typically sends (PartnerPaper_Proposed.docx) — it contains the pass-through clause we prefer.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept the pass-through carve-out in the Partner Paper and a matching Order Form clause? If not, what language would you be comfortable with? We have a hard deadline to get final terms into GCP by the 1st week of March to make the March launch.

High level asks:
- Pass-through of marketplace charges to end customers (no markup by Redwood)
- Mirror language in Order Form to avoid double billing
- Standard reseller warranty/indemnity language (we've redlined our normal template in the attachment)

CC'd Carlos from our operations team — he's on the technical side of the marketplace flow. Happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Emma Jones
Head of Partnerships | CloudResellCo
emma.jones@cloudresellco.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Partner paper & pass-through request — CloudResellCo / Redwood

Emma — thanks for sending this over and flagging the timeline. We're keen to support the marketplace launch. A few items up-front so we can align with Product/Finance/Legal:

1) Can you confirm the exact GCP SKU billing flow (invoice from GCP to end-customer, Redwood receives settlement vs. Redwood billed and then billed back)? Some pass-through asks are dependent on that flow.
2) Which clauses in your PartnerPaper are mandatory vs. preferred? If you can highlight the must-haves that helps speed review.

I've looped in Karthik (Channel Partnerships) and Laura (Legal) to help review the redlines and propose language that keeps us compliant with our MSA and Order Form structure. Marcus from Finance will need to sign off on the passthrough mechanics — I've asked Legal to call that out.

Next step: Laura, can you take the attached partner paper and produce a redline with recommended edits for the pass-through and Order Form mirror language? If possible, include an alternate clause that limits Redwood's liability exposure for marketplace settlements.

Emma — I'll follow up once we have the legal redline. If we hit questions that need Ops input, Carlos, would you be able to share a short diagram of the billing flow?

Best,

— Soojin Lee

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: soojin.lee@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Partner paper & pass-through request — CloudResellCo / Redwood

Soojin / Karthik — I reviewed the PartnerPaper_Proposed.docx and prepared PartnerPaper_Redline_v2.docx (attached). Summary below for quick read:

Summary of legal review (top-level):
- Pass-through clause: acceptable with limits. We can agree to a pass-through of marketplace fees provided:
  - Redwood is not responsible for marketplace's collection practices (explicit carve-out).
  - Pricing/discounting disputes remain between reseller and end-customer; Redwood requires indemnification if claims are routed to us.
- Order Form mirror: recommend an Order Form addendum that states Redwood will accept marketplace billing flows only if (i) reseller provides monthly settlement report, and (ii) reseller agrees to credit back end-customers for demonstrable double-billing events.
- Liability: cap exposure to the amounts actually collected by Redwood under the Order Form during the preceding 12 months.
- Audit rights: limit to annual on-site or remote audit with 30 days' notice — no fishing expeditions.

Open questions for Finance (Marcus):
- Do we need a separate escrow or reserve for disputed marketplace settlements?
- Are there tax implications for passthrough vs. resale treatment in our reporting?

Suggested next steps:
1) Legal: finalize PartnerPaper redline (attached) and a one-paragraph Order Form addendum.
2) Finance: confirm settlement/reporting requirements and whether reserves are needed.
3) Ops (Carlos): provide billing flow diagram and example settlement report.

I will attach a short memo as the first page of PartnerPaper_Redline_v2.docx. Marcus — please prioritize so we can hit Emma's deadline.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: PartnerPaper_Redline_v2.docx (docx - redline + memo)

Hi team,

- That the Order Form will include language mirroring marketplace billing so that the end-customer invoice references the marketplace SKU and not a Redwood-managed invoice number.
- A contact for settlement reconciliation and a cadence (monthly recommended).
- An approved pass-through clause in the Partner Paper before we allow the listing to go live (approval workflow takes ~3 business days once legal approves).

If Redwood can return the redlined Order Form and confirm settlement contact by Feb 28 EOD PT, we can commit to the March launch timeline.

Regards,
GCP Partner Listings Team
